description: Another lender's repayment record of an agent or a wallet: Priors' record on Robinhood Chain (loans repaid and their USDG, loans open, any default, its Priors Score v2 and rung), read live from Priors' check API and given in Borro's own words. agent: an ERC-8004 agent id; address: a wallet (an agent's, a payee's, an x402 payTo), which finds the agents it owns or pays for (at most 3 shown, best rung ahead); exactly one. It is Priors' record, not Borro's, and Borro does not vouch for it: check_on_chain says how to read Priors' score from the ERC-8004 registry yourself. verdict: no record, no repayments yet, repaid or defaulted. proven is true when a listed agent has a published Priors Score v2 at rung 2 or more (proven: three or more backed repayments over 14 days or more, none late), no default and is not frozen; anything missing counts as not proven. credit_open, credit_line, credit_guardrails, credit_pay, credit_bill, hold_open and account_open show the same record as agent_record or payee_record when Priors answers within 2.5 seconds.
name: counterparty_check
title: Check a counterparty's repayment record
